_evidence: 0x0040ad35 and 0x0040ad7c walk the 0x160-byte record array at 0x008943a0 testing dword +0x2c against 0x10 or 0x20 (chosen by the sign of byte 0x00868582). 0x0040ad35 starts at [0x00866ecc]-0x580 (4 records back) and stops at [0x00866f00]; 0x0040ad7c starts at record 4 and stops at [0x00866f04]. The end pointers are record-aligned addresses inside the array, so each is base + k*0x160. 26 records are varied.
